changes.text: Main window: shortcuts — Alt+1…4 modules, Ctrl+T day scale, Ctrl+. settings, Ctrl+R refresh, Ctrl+U check for updates
Exchange: a new task with a due date gets the same start date
Tempo: timer — start on an issue, stop to log it, tray line and dot, reminders when long or a meeting begins
Day scale: drag to move, drag an edge to resize own events, Tempo worklogs and organized meetings
Tempo: worklogs on the day scale and in the calendar window, meetings marked as logged
Jira: Tempo module — today's worklogs, log time from the tab, the tray or a meeting, favorite and recent issues
Settings: working day start and end, the default start of new time entries
Settings: one domain account shared by Exchange and Jira
Main window: events, local events, tasks and flagged mail in one time-ordered list
Main window: day dividers between past days, today and the next day
